Submit and verify the project appears in the project list (list views refresh asynchronously after a create, so wait for the row to appear). Report the project name as shown in the list and any other fields you had to fill in.

In the project '{{runid}} MTP Bench Project', edit the line item '{{runid}} MTP Item A' to change its cost from 100 to 150 (keep markup 25). Save the change and report the new price the app computes for '{{runid}} MTP Item A' as shown on the page, and confirm the cost now reads 150.

In the project '{{runid}} MTP Bench Project', change the line item '{{runid}} MTP Item A' status from '{{03-open.initial_status}}' to 'Specified'. The app enforces preconditions before it will accept that status — if it refuses, read the error/validation message, discover exactly what is required, satisfy those requirements (e.g. filling missing fields on the item or related records), and retry until the status is saved as 'Specified'. Report the final status shown for '{{runid}} MTP Item A' and exactly what was required to satisfy the preconditions (quote the error text and what you did about it).

In the project '{{runid}} MTP Bench Project', delete both line items '{{runid}} MTP Item A' and '{{runid}} MTP Item B' (confirm any deletion dialogs). Then close/archive the project '{{runid}} MTP Bench Project' so nothing from this run is left active — use whatever close/archive action the app provides (e.g. a status change to Closed/Archived on the project). Verify both items are gone from the Project Items list (lists refresh asynchronously, so wait for the rows to disappear) and report the project's final status and any confirmation text shown.
